children.name: text
children.label: Heading
children.default: AI agents that work inside your OMS rules

children.name: description
children.label: Intro
children.help_text: Shown under the heading. Leave empty to hide it.
children.default: Ask in plain words. Every agent works with only the tools you grant it, and you decide which actions need a person’s approval.

children.name: anchor_id
children.label: Anchor ID
children.help_text: Optional. Letters, numbers, dashes or underscores only. Lets other links jump to this section.

name: cards
label: Cards
help_text: Made for a black section. Each card shows a name, a role, a question that types out when the card comes on screen, and the answer.

children.name: subtitle
children.label: Role
children.help_text: Shown in capitals on its own line under the name.

children.name: question
children.label: Question
children.help_text: Shown after “You ask”. Keep it to one or two lines.

default.title: Circuit
default.subtitle: For operations
default.question: Cut split shipments this week without slowing delivery.
default.description: Circuit drafts an editable routing proposal, backed by your order and inventory data. Accept or discard each change, simulate it on the same orders, and nothing changes in live routing until you save.

default.title: AI CSR Agent
default.subtitle: For customer service
default.question: Where is order NN#10209 right now?
default.description: The agent answers with the order’s status, stock, fulfillment details, and any exceptions in one reply, so reps don’t hunt across screens.

default.title: Inventory Optimization Agent
default.subtitle: For planners
default.question: Which stores are about to run out of our best sellers?
default.description: The agent shows where stock is exposed and how to position it across stores and warehouses. Your team decides what to move.

default.title: Agent Composer and MCP Server
default.subtitle: For your own team
default.question: Connect Claude to our order and inventory data.
default.description: Build your own agents in Agent Composer, or connect Claude, Codex, or Antigravity through the MCP Server.

children.name: background_color
children.label: Background color
children.help_text: Card colour. The default is white at 7% opacity, for a black section.
